api.mutateCompanyLocation (write): Creates, updates or deletes one location (address) of a customer or vendor company.
api.searchUsers (read): Searches Distru users — the caller's teammates within their company, e.g.
api.getCompany (read): Gets one company by ID — a customer, a vendor, or the user's own company (isMyCompany): the api.searchCompanies summary plus its US state, description, default sales and purchase order notes, and the emails its documents go to.
api.mutateCompanyContact (write): Creates, updates or deletes one contact (a person) at a customer or vendor company, or at your own.
api.mutateCompany (write): Creates, updates or deletes one customer or vendor company; UPDATE also takes your own company (isMyCompany), which DELETE refuses.
api.mutateCompanyLicense (write): Creates, updates or deletes one license of a customer or vendor company.
api.getMe (read): Gets the authenticated user and their company setup: timezone, US state, compliance system, active modules and key inventory and sales settings.
api.reportSalesTotals (read): Sales totals over a date range, one row per what rowsPer picks.
